We have commissioned a custom acoustic rig specifically tuned for this space:

▪ Subwoofers tuned to 25 Hz — bass you feel in your chest, not just your ears.
▪ Point-source mid/high array for surgical clarity at high SPL.
▪ Acoustic treatment to minimise slapback echo in the industrial space.
▪ Sound engineered by producers who understand techno dynamics.

Ear protection available at the door.

Bring your hearing. We will take care of the rest.

caption:
The dancefloor is a sacred space.

Our house rules are non-negotiable:

[01] NO PHOTO / NO VIDEO POLICY ON THE DANCEFLOOR.
Phone cameras will be taped at entry. Be present.

[02] ZERO TOLERANCE FOR HARASSMENT.
Any form of racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, or unwanted physical contact results in immediate removal.

[03] LOOK AFTER ONE ANOTHER.
If you or someone around you needs assistance, alert our awareness team wearing cyan bands.

[04] DRESS TO EXPRESS, NOT TO IMPRESS.
Come as you are. All bodies, all identities welcome.
